verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing says it can launch automated actions from any change in CRM fields or user activity, move pipeline stages on trigger events, automate tasks, and send alerts on key updates. Together these cover triggers, record updates, task creation and notifications, but only as one-line marketing claims. Missing for 10: in-depth workflow-builder documentation, explicit evidence of updating arbitrary record fields (beyond pipeline stages) and creating tasks as workflow actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Launch automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity.
Adjust stages of the pipeline based on any trigger event.
Automate tasks and get alerts for key updates to stay on track.
Modify fields, pipeline stages, views, and automations to match your unique processes.
